title_1: Secretary General Dou Linping of China Lighting Society visited Chuanglian Power Supply for guidance
data_2:
On December 21, 2018, Secretary General Dou Linping of China Lighting Society visited Chuanglian Power Supply for guidance. Tang Jingxin, Chairman of Chuanglian Power Supply, and the company's management team warmly received and accompanied the visit.
 

	
 
Secretary-General Dou Linping visited the cultural exhibition hall, production line and research and development center of Chuanglian Power Supply successively, learned about Chuanglian's research and development strength and production technology level on the spot, and inquired deeply about the product advantages and usage of Chuanglian Power Supply.
 

	
 
Chairman Tang Jingxin introduced the company's annual operating status and technical service operation mode to Secretary-General Dou Linping in detail, and described the future strategic development plan of Chuanglian Power. Chuanglian always adheres to innovation-driven, and strictly controls product quality. It has always been committed to creating a high quality LED drive power supply, and continuously creating a high-quality and efficient marketing system from the aspects of brand promotion, channel construction, product service, etc. Tang Dong also said that the rapid development of Chuanglian Power is inseparable from the support of industry leaders, and sincerely thanks the industry leaders for their love and trust in Chuanglian.
 

	
 
Secretary-General Dou Linping fully affirmed and praised Chuanglian Power's current achievements and the company's development momentum, congratulated the company on its achievements, and put forward a series of forward-looking suggestions. Secretary-General Dou expressed the hope that Chuanglian Power can continue to uphold the excellent product concept, maintain a strong momentum of development, and look forward to the future development of Chuanglian Power.

item_page_title: Chuanglian Power Supply Held 2018 5S Site Management Commendation Conference
title_1: Chuanglian Power Supply Held 2018 5S Site Management Commendation Conference
data_2:
In order to strengthen the company's standardized management and improve production efficiency, the company has implemented 5S work since September. With the high attention of the company's leaders and the joint efforts of various departments, it has achieved phased results through more than 4 months of persistence. At noon on December 29, 2018, executive vice president of chuanglian power supply, ding manfeng, together with expert Lu, leaders of various departments and award-winning personnel, held the 2018 5S on-site management commendation conference in the company's training room.
 

	
 
Teacher Lu, a consultant from Kehui, made wonderful comments on the overall results of the company's 5S. She said: 5S management has achieved a lot after more than 4 months of persistence, and has been significantly improved in terms of reasonable positioning, neat placement, and clear signs. At the same time, Mr. Lu suggested that we should find problems and improve them in time, eliminate all kinds of waste, improve production efficiency, and make 5S persistent.
 

	
 
Executive Vice President Ding Manfeng, consulting expert Lu and leaders of various departments commended the advanced collectives and individuals emerging in 5S management and awarded prizes. Ding congratulated the winners and encouraged everyone to play an exemplary and leading role in the follow-up production activities and continue to cultivate management.
 

	
 

	
 
Ding Zong delivered a summary speech in warm applause. Ding Zong highly agreed with the results of the 5S start-up phase, and requested to expand the 5S management mode from the production department to all departments of the company, requiring all employees to participate, the production workshop should actively share successful experiences, and the follow-up company should develop 5S normal management.

title_1: Fight the epidemic and overcome the difficulties! Letter to Chuanglian Power Customers
data_2:
Dear customers and partners:

	Good New Year everyone!

	First of all, I would like to thank the customers all over the country for their trust and support to Chuanglian Power Supply! Since the start of the fight against the pneumonia epidemic infected by the new coronavirus, the people of the whole country have been united in the prevention and control of the epidemic. In order to actively prevent and control the epidemic, protect the health and safety of all employees of the company, and protect the stable development of partners, Chuanglian Power actively responded to the call of the government and strictly followed the requirements of the Changzhou Municipal Government, strictly achieve the prevention and control mechanism in place, personnel investigation in place, facilities and materials in place, internal management in place "four in place", successfully passed the government's approval to resume work, and this month17Work began to resume from the day.
 

	The current is still a critical period of epidemic prevention and control, the creation of the power supply will strictly implement the measures, do a good job of epidemic prevention and control, gather all forces to ensure that the company's safe and orderly production, production capacity will be gradually restored. Due to the impact of the epidemic control, most areas of transportation and logistics transportation has yet to be gradually restored, in the short term on the upstream and downstream raw material supply, logistics and transportation, production supporting there is a certain impact, so that we have delayed the service, during the epidemic to you inconvenience, we apologize, please understand!
 

	In order to minimize personnel contact and ensure safety, Chuanglian Power proposes that our sales and technical service personnel work online, timely by telephone,QQWeChat and other remote communication methods keep in touch and communicate with customers to ensure the orderly progress of daily work and meet customer needs.
 

	In this battle against the epidemic without gunpowder smoke, Chuanglian Power Supply will work together with everyone to overcome the difficulties, fight the epidemic, and welcome the warm spring flowers together!
 
 

	Changzhou Chuanglian Power Technology Co., Ltd.

On November 30, the building structure of the Chuanglian Power Supply · High-end Intelligent Power Supply Industrialization Project constructed by Feifeng Building was successfully capped, marking a phased victory in the construction of the project, and also laying a foundation for the subsequent secondary structure and initial decoration projects. Solid foundation. 
  
 Changzhou Chuanglian Power Technology Co., Ltd. newly built high-end intelligent power supply industrialization project, covering an area of about 40 acres, with a construction area of 54857.8 square meters. The project plans to build several full-automatic intelligent manufacturing production lines, flexible intelligent production lines, SMT patch production lines and AI automatic plug-in production lines, etc. It is planned to establish Chuanglian Intelligent Warehouse (CTU)-automatic intelligent warehouse management system and intelligent manufacturing information system, etc. It is planned to build a world-class high-end intelligent power supply industry center, an industry-leading product research and development center and a verification center. 
 Chuanglian Power was founded in March 2000. It is a national-level specialized and special new "little giant" enterprise and high-tech enterprise integrating R & D, manufacturing, sales and service. The company has two power research and development center teams in Changzhou and Shenzhen, and has set up post-doctoral research workstations to aim at the cutting-edge technology of global switching power supplies and comprehensively enhance the key core technology and independent innovation capability of Chuanglian Power Supply. 
 The company's products include three series of LED display power supply, industrial control power supply and lighting power supply, with more than 2000 standard models, providing all-round power supply solutions for global customers. Products are used in: LED display, industrial automation, industrial electronic equipment, instrumentation, power, communications, transportation, engineering lighting, new energy and other industries. Products are exported to Europe and the United States, Africa, Latin America, the Middle East, Southeast Asia and other more than 50 countries and regions, favored by customers, annual production and sales of more than 20 million sets.
